name: multi-dap-vscode
description: Local Debug Adapter Protocol integration for multi-dap

scripts.lint: node --check src/extension.js && node --check test/extension.test.js && node --check scripts/list-package-files.js

author: Tacrolimus

configFile.description: Absolute path to the multi-dap project TOML configuration.

controlDirectory.description: Optional absolute path to multi-dap's private control-record directory.

perfOutput.description: Optional absolute path, after variable substitution, to a new private host-latency capture file. The parent directory must exist; existing files are never overwritten.

perfMaxEvents.description: Optional retained-event limit for host-latency capture. Requires perfOutput; omission uses the CLI's default limit.

configurationSnippets.label: Attach to multi-dap
configurationSnippets.description: Connect through the authenticated local multi-dap proxy.

multiDap.executable.description: Path or command name for the local multi-dap executable.
